steps.title: Roll +1 minion and an open suffix
steps.action: Use Deafening Essence of Fear on the acquired ilvl83 rare Convoking Wand with exactly20% fractured minion Attack/Cast Speed.

evidence.method: Current Craft of Exile calculator UI and successful outcome plus ordinary paid failure reroll
evidence.settings: Rare uninfluenced Convoking Wand exactly ilvl83; pre-acquired fractured minion Attack and Cast Speed exactly20%; Deafening Essence of Fear guarantees83–94% increased minion damage; AND +1 all Minion Skill Gems and at least1 open suffix. Bench Trigger8s after success. No Annul, Vesper, self-fracture or premium hybrid damage assumed.
evidence.assumptions: Displayed0.516% chance and194 mean Fear are rounded. Same reusable base; every failed roll pays another Fear. Trigger bench3Chaos once; one Scouring reserved conservatively for Remove Crafted Modifiers only, never scour the whole item. Listing asks do not prove sales/profit; gold/time excluded.

steps.continueWhen: +1 all Minion Skill Gems AND at least1 open suffix; essence minion damage83–94 and the fracture remain.
steps.failureAction: Repeat one paid Fear on the same base, including +1 results with full suffixes. Do not Annul or Scour.

steps.title: Bench Trigger8s
steps.action: Bench Trigger a Socketed Spell when you Use a Skill, with8secondCooldown for3Chaos. Keep1Scouring as a conservative reserve for bench Remove Crafted Modifiers if needed; never apply it to the item.

Bench Trigger8s after success. No Annul, Vesper, self-fracture or premium hybrid damage assumed.

steps.continueWhen: Trigger8s present together with the +1minion/damage/fractured-speed core.
steps.failureAction: Stop if the suffix is unavailable; that outcome belongs to the paid Fear reroll stage.

steps.title: Roll both gem prefixes
steps.action: Use Corroded, Jagged, Metallic and Shuddering Fossils in one four-socket chaotic resonator on the acquired uninfluenced rare Convoking Wand.

evidence.method: Manually checked current Craft of Exile calculator; rounded displayed probability/mean consumption and complete outcome plus ordinary paid failure reroll
evidence.settings: Rare uninfluenced Convoking Wand ilvl84, no corruption/fracture/synthesis. One Corroded + Jagged + Metallic + Shuddering Fossil in one Prime Chaotic Resonator per attempt. AND +1allMinionSkillGems and +1allSpellSkillGems. Stop at functional+2; no open suffix, trigger or bench finish required. Native implicit minion damage is preserved; no numerical implicit floor is required.
evidence.assumptions: Independent rerolls on the same reusable acquired rare base, one material set per attempt. Current CoE displayed mean 12 sets is rounded; cost/ROI remain indicative. No replacement or finishing stage, in-game spending, executed purchase, sale or whole-build validation.

steps.continueWhen: +1 to Level of all Spell Skill Gems AND +1 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems on the same wand.
steps.failureAction: Repeat the paid fossil combination on the same base; previous explicit modifiers are discarded. Stop at this functional +2 target. No unverified trigger, multimod or other finish is required.

saleEvidence.reason: The priced +2 wands have additional minion speed and/or paid finishes outside this two-prefix craft model. An equivalent core-only sale price has not been established.

steps.title: Roll both supports
steps.action: Use Harvest Reforge Fire on the acquired rare Elder Archdemon Crown. Each attempt costs 50 Wild Crystallised Lifeforce.

evidence.method: Manually checked current CoE joint support+open-prefix probability and ordinary paidreforge; both complete core+paidbench finishes executed in public UI
evidence.settings: Acquired rare Elder-only Archdemon Crown ilvl83, unfractured/uncorrupted/unsynthesised, native+2socketedSkillGems/-2socketedSupportGems. Harvest ReforgeFire50Wild perattempt. AND ConcentratedEffect supporttier1(level20) + BurningDamage supporttier1(level20) + at least1OpenPrefix. Then once bench8–10%AoE/+1socketedAoEGems for4Chaos; all8–10values satisfy the target, no exact10retry.
evidence.assumptions: Same acquired Elder rarebase reused,50Wild eachreforge; joint successincludesbothsupports andopenprefix. Expectedperfinisheditem: 910 roundedreforges plus exactlyone4Chaosbench; onebase, noScouring/replacement. All8–10AoErollsaccepted. No empirical game spending/sales or whole-build fit.

steps.continueWhen: Burning Damage and Concentrated Effect both level 20 or higher, and at least one open prefix.
steps.failureAction: Repeat on the same base; reject a desired pair with no open prefix. The reforge replaces all explicit modifiers and previous bench craft; it preserves influence and native implicits.
